title: Invariance Under a Fixed XOR Mask
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb{N}$, let $c$ be a Boolean vector of length $m$, and let $P$ be any property of finite Boolean lists. If a uniformly random Boolean list of length $m$ is combined entrywise by exclusive-or with $c$, the probability that the resulting list satisfies $P$ equals the probability that the original random list satisfies $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean vector of length $m$
